_readme: The rules a creator's gift order must pass to be approved without a person.
An order that breaks any rule waits in Gift orders under 'Needs approval' with the reason.
Edit the values, redeploy, and the new rules apply to the next order. Every approved order's
activity log names the rules it passed; every held order names the rule it failed.

allowedCountries.about: Ship only to these countries by itself. Anywhere else needs a person.

maxQuantity.about: Most items a single order may hold.

maxProductPriceUsd.about: Most expensive product (Amazon price) that goes out without a person. A product with no known price is allowed.

repeatGiftDays.about: A second gift to the same creator within this many days needs a person.

paidCollaborationNeedsApprovedFee.about: A paid collaboration is only approved by itself once a person has approved the fee.
